title: Studio landing: the description and read-only hint still say to customize a read-only package "with an environment overlay", which ADR-0146 closed
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① user-facing copy that contradicts a landed decision. Found by #28579 slice 2 (PR #29487, `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §14c) and confirmed by the seat on `main`.
Reader: `domain:ui`. The copy is in `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and its locale twins. The pin is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `"environment overlay" studio landing` → no copy card. #29374 (N-31, open) covers docs and the turned-off sentence, and its "Not here" leaves the Studio i18n strings out. #28576 (closed) closed the package-less write itself.
reach: every Studio visitor. It is the landing page of the builder.
type: Bug

Business reason: the first thing Studio tells a user about a read-only package is to customize it "with an environment overlay". Since ADR-0146 D11 (#28576 / #28850), a package-less write onto a packaged view or dashboard answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` and names the `<base>.custom` pair. The route the landing page teaches is now refused.

## Where (read on `main`)
- `engine.studio.landing.description` (`en.ts` line 3237): "…Code and installed packages are read-only: browse them here, and customize them with an environment overlay."
- `engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint` (`en.ts` line 3250): "…Customize one with an environment overlay, for the metadata types that accept one."
- `BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts` requires that phrase, so the copy cannot change without changing the pin.

## Wanted
Point both strings, and their locale twins, at the ADR-0146 route: customize in the package's `.custom` pair (Customize / New similar), with upgrades still flowing to the base. Re-pin the test on the new wording, and say whether any metadata type still takes a package-less environment overlay. Copy and pin only, with no behaviour change.
